verdict.rationale: Grafana supports querying/visualizing/alerting across many backends (Prometheus, Loki, Tempo, etc.) via a pluggable data-source model, which aligns with 'switch backends without re-instrumenting,' and Tempo/traces integration nods to OpenTelemetry-style tracing. However, the evidence doesn't explicitly discuss OpenTelemetry SDK instrumentation or standards-based instrumentation portability itself — Grafana is the backend/visualization layer, not the instrumentation library. missing for 10: explicit OTel SDK/collector instrumentation guidance, direct claims about vendor-neutral instrumentation portability, independent evidence confirming backend-switching works seamlessly in practice without code changes.
